rulings.Rulings: Real Property/Housing Court Law and Motion Calendar for August 12, 2026. Line 20. DEFENDANT KARI ORVIK, VERO MAJANO DEMURRER to COMPLAINT is SUSTAINED without leave to amend. The Notice is fatally defective. It does not accurately describe the "the right the tenant(s) may have to relocation costs." While Plaintiff argues in opposition that the inclusion of the inaccurate language (summarizing the triggering event for the second half of base and additional relocation costs) does not "displace code compliant disclosure" and does not "render those disclosures ineffective," this argument is not followed by any citation to authority. SFRO and Rules and regulations require a written notification of the rights tenants may have to relocation costs. The language in the Notice does not accurately describe the right to receive the second half of the payments and is at odds with the language regarding those rights contained in SFRP 37.9C, a copy of which is attached to the Notice. Compare: "when you vacate the premises" (Notice), and "when the unit is vacated" (SFRO 37.9C(e)(1), and "when Eligible tenant Vacated the unit."
